The issuer demonstrates solid profitability with a net income of $242M on revenue of $1,264M (an impressive net margin of ~19.1%) and a healthy equity cushion of $1,997M backed by substantial retained earnings. However, the financial profile reflects significant leverage, evidenced by a high debt-to-equity ratio driven by total liabilities of $10,429M against $13,067M in total assets (a leverage ratio of nearly 80%). Taking into account the strong earning power balanced against high financial leverage typical of a investment-grade financial or asset-heavy institution, the company warrants a solid mid-investment-grade rating.

DECISION: BBB
